# Topography (`topography`)

A living contour map with shaded relief.

- Type: scene (draws its own image; put it first)
- Reacts to: nothing outside itself (pure motion)
- Cost: heavy (~7.8 ms/frame at 5K on a Pro GPU)
- Built-in styles: Topography

## Params

| key | label | kind | range / options | default |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `lines` | Lines | slider | 8 … 60 | 30 |
| `scale` | Terrain Scale | slider | 0.5 … 3 | 1.2 |
| `speed` | Speed | slider | 0 … 2 | 0.5 |
| `fill` | Relief Shading | slider | 0 … 1 | 0.5 |

## Colours

| slot | label | default |
|---|---|---|
| `colorA` | Ground | {"r":0.05,"g":0.06,"b":0.07} |
| `colorB` | Lines | {"r":0.93,"g":0.9,"b":0.82} |
